data.narrative:
Irradiant Technologies is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Daniel Oran and Amos Meeks. The company has raised $8.5M to date. The comparable universe includes one public company (277810.KQ) and eight private peers in the robotics and manufacturing sector, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Valuation analysis was conducted using stage-progression methodology, as peer-median comparison was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables (only one Seed-stage peer identified; minimum three required for statistical reliability). The stage-progression method applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier to the $8.5M total raised as a proxy for current valuation, implying a post-Seed valuation of $21.3M. This multiplier reflects typical dilution and value progression from Seed to Series A in the robotics sector.

The triangulated valuation range supported by available data is $18M to $24M, with a median of $21M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single applicable methodology rather than cross-method triangulation. Key uncertainties include the lack of adequate Seed-stage peer data within robotics and manufacturing, which limits confidence in the 2.5x multiplier's appropriateness for this specific target. Refinement of this valuation would benefit from additional Seed-stage or early Series A comparables with disclosed valuation data.
